# Spline

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 6 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Dark 3D-tool marketing: black page, Geist display, pill CTAs, translucent nav, plan columns.

Captured 2026-11-19, public marketing, plus a signed-out email signup that stopped before the company step. Themes: dark.

Spline's public marketing site and the signed-out sign-in shell, captured on 19 November 2026. Marketing pages stay dark. The app shell is a second dark UI. Widths are 1440 and 390 CSS pixels. An email signup was started and stopped on the company step. No payment was entered.

The public site tree was mapped again on 22 November 2026. The empty sign-in wall was photographed. No email was typed on that pass. See site-tree.md.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Geist and Geist Mono are loaded by the marketing site as next/font files. Spline Sans Regular and Medium are self-hosted at `/fonts/SplineSans-Regular.woff2` and `/fonts/SplineSans-Medium.woff2`. Brockmann is also declared and was not the computed face of the elements that were measured. The font files are not committed. Tokens name Geist and Spline Sans with system fallbacks.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The marketing body element computes a line-height of 18.4px. The body token uses the hero paragraph's 24px. The primary button's computed radius is 999px. The stylesheet says 999px. Hero weight is 450, which the cascade also declares as 500 on headings. The token keeps the computed 450. There is no light theme. A dark colour scheme was active and the marketing page did not offer a light switch. Geist and Spline Sans are not in the package. The style guide names them and falls back. The enterprise members table is a public demo. Its row colours were not measured. App ramps (`--color-blue-100` through `--color-yellow-900`) were read and are not tokenised one step at a time. The accent, success, danger, and the elevation opacities that were used are tokenised.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the light pill for the primary action.** Start building and Get Pro are `#eee` with black type and a 999px radius. [components/crops/button-primary-default.png](components/crops/button-primary-default.png)
- **Set display type in Geist.** Hero, section, and plan names are Geist at weight 450 with a tight negative tracking. [screenshots/home-dark-default.png](screenshots/home-dark-default.png)
- **Keep the marketing site on black.** The page colour is `#000`. The app shell is a separate `#1e1e1e`. [screenshots/pricing-dark-default.png](screenshots/pricing-dark-default.png)
- **Leave payment and company forms out.** Checkout was not opened. The company step was not submitted. [patterns.md](patterns.md)
